title: Kiritani Haruka — Plotting A Surprise〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka, there you are.
That just leaves Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why don't we start warming up while we wait for her to arrive?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, but... There's something I'd like to discuss before she does.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What do you wanna discuss?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Remember how Minori told us yesterday that she'll be shadowing at Animal Land?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I thought we could also go in secret and meet up with her around the time she finishes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You wanna surprise her?
As fun as that sounds, sorry... I've already made plans to check out a cafe that serves Japanese sweets with a friend.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sorry, I also can't go. I need to go to the store to buy some archery equipment...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... That's okay if you've both already made plans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you shouldn't let this opportunity slip. Why don't you go with someone you became friends with last year?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That could also work...
Thanks, I'll try asking around!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope your surprise goes well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Who would be able to go...?
Hmm...)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ichika? Are you about to have lunch?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm thinking about getting some bread from the school store.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
Actually... I'm really glad I ran into you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You are?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Ichi! Hi, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You two probably haven't eaten yet, right? Wanna have lunch together?! It's been so long!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. What do you think, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, of course.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! The Class 1-C BFFs are back as a team!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It has been a little while.
Anyway, let's go grab something to eat.
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm glad we got to have lunch together again despite being in different classes now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. The three of us meeting up almost feels like a pseudo-class reunion!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By the way, Haruka, you wanted to talk to me about something?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
You and Saki both showed up just at the right time. I was just wondering...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you two free the Saturday after next?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori and Shiho are going over to Animal Land to shadow as caretakers. I was hoping to secretly go there around the time they finish.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You mean...like a surprise?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We could jump out right when they wrap things up for the day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I see. So we wouldn't be interfering while they're working. I am free, and going to the zoo does sound like fun...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? Then, Saki, how about you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I... I really wanna go...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I already made plans to go clothes shopping with friends that day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm missing out on something that sounds super fun! But I can't on my friends since I'm the one who invited them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's too bad that you can't go, Saki... But try to cheer up! We'll bring back some nice souvenirs for you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Cry*
That isn't making me feel any better!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Then, how about this?
We'll come up with a way to surprise you some other time, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A surprise for me?! What are you gonna do?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Telling you would defeat the purpose.
So, it'll be a secret until then.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, that does sound like fun.
I'll help.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Th-Th-That...
That sounds super duper amazing! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm glad you're feeling better now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll need to come up with a really good surprise for her, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Let's both give her the best surprise we can.
